items.title: Sleep Story: The Great Library of Alexandria | Calm Ancient History (48 Min)
items.description:
Follow a single scroll through ancient Alexandria on a calm evening around 230 BC. It arrives on a merchant ship from Rhodes beneath the fire of the Pharos lighthouse, travels along the colonnades of the Canopic Way, passes the palms and the moonlit pool of the garden of the Muses, is copied by lamplight with a reed pen, finds its place on the honeycomb shelves of the Great Library, and ends the night on a flat roof in the hands of Eratosthenes, the man who measured the world.

No battles and no burning, only slow narration, soft rain and a long ambient ending so you can drift off.
